description_en: Retrieves the parallel paths of uplink data packets for a node by calling ListNodeTransferPacketPaths
description_zh: 调用ListNodeTransferPacketPaths获取节点上行数据包的平行路径
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-node-transfer-packet-paths --iot-instance-id example-string --dev-eui 0000000000000001 --base64-encoded-mac-payload xxx --log-millis 14643600000 --page-number 1 --page-size 2 --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodeTransferPacketPaths

parameters.help_en: The MacPayload of the data packet. You can obtain this value from the response of the **ListNodeGroupTransferPackets** operation
